text: Prime Chancellor of the Realm
There must always be a loyal high-ranking official who assists the king closely in all affairs.
High Spokesman of the Clans

Grand General of the Armies
The Grand General commands all the soldiers of the nation, but it is the king who grants that authority.
Grand Minister of Finance
Oversees the entire national treasury - a role that demands a person of impeccable integrity.
Grand Minister of Education
Education is the most important means of reforming people, as the wise of old would always say when teaching.
Minister of Ceremonies
Royal etiquette and ceremonies are not only national events but also occasions to consider the welfare of the people.
Minister of Inspections
Before issuing punishment, thoroughly investigating the matter is the foundation for fair judgment.
Minister of the Guards
Protecting the king and high ministers is one of the nation's most critical duties.
Minister of Public Works
Constructing planned cities and buildings requires someone who can set and maintain a perfect foundation.
Minister of Personnel
Any place that manages its people effectively holds the greatest power.
Minister of Industry Development
The first step in developing culture is having the technical skills to bring imagination to life.
Minister of Horse Management
Is it worth appointing a minister just for horse management? Absolutely!
Minister of Justice
If one breaks the law, no matter how high their status, they cannot escape humiliation.
Minister of Foreign Affairs
The crucial first step in opening relations with foreign nations is choosing the right person to send there.
